subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Mark Twain and Humorous Storytelling
description: Learn Mark Twain and Humorous Storytelling in one minute.

hook.text: Mark Twain became famous overnight with a short story about a jumping frog in a California mining camp.

buildup.text: The Celebrated Jumping Frog of Calaveras County used frontier dialect humor to mock intellectual pretension.

discovery.text: Twain mastered the tall tale tradition, where exaggeration and deadpan delivery create comic effect.

twist.text: His humor always carried a sharp edge: he used comedy to attack racism, imperialism, and religious hypocrisy.

climax.text: Twain proved that the American short story could be both wildly funny and devastatingly political at once.

punchline.text: A frog story launched the career of America's sharpest satirist.

quiz.question: What deeper purpose did Twain's humor serve?
options: It was purely for entertainment with no deeper meaning
He used comedy to attack racism, imperialism, and hypocrisy
He was only trying to sell newspapers
